eventMetadata.context_description: The onset of the southwest monsoon, or habagat, is the primary driver positioning 31–32°C as the market’s leading outcomes for Manila’s June 1 high. PAGASA’s latest extended outlook forecasts a 30°C daytime maximum with a 60% chance of rain on June 1, reflecting increased cloud cover and scattered thunderstorms that typically suppress peak temperatures during the seasonal transition. Late-May observations showed highs of 33–35°C under drier conditions, but persistent westerly wind bursts and rising humidity are expected to moderate readings. June climatology places average highs near 32°C, with model consensus indicating limited potential for 34°C or higher absent a clear break in monsoon flow. Updated PAGASA guidance and short-range model runs over the next 48 hours will provide the next key data points for traders.
